objective: Distinguish current grasp/measurement mismatch, validate one justified local repair, then collect a small fixed-version pilot.

budget.outer_development_usage: Current chat; get_goal usage recorded, no controllable hard token cap or billing data available. No external model call authorized by this proposal.
budget.outer_budget_accounting: Snapshot get_goal tokensUsed at authorization start; do not start another analysis chunk with less than50000 remaining. No platform hard cap; record any in-flight overrun and stop. Prior usage is retained, never reset.

decision_scope: First acquire current RGB/CAN without movement and reconcile safe start and empty/loaded gripper state.
Select one low-cost discriminating observation of aperture or plug-to-finger pose using existing interfaces. Grasp/lift or gripper-only movement counts as a development attempt.
Keep original speed and safety gates; no increase in torque, no fixture modification, no unvalidated full insertion.
Any changed reference must pass current-source simulation and frozen replay before real execution. An interrupted motion needs a validated recovery, never an improvised finish.
If observation supports a local candidate, at most two development real attempts total; if no useful gain/evidence, stop early.
Only after development physical success and valid recording freeze reference/model/controller/recorder/success criteria; start five independent manual-reset acceptance attempts.

acceptance.training_eligibility: Keep native false unless an existing independently verified admission path applies; valid successful recording is not automatically a training demonstration.
acceptance.denominator: All started attempts; development separate; no historical successes or log rechecks added. A failure ends this pilot and leaves remaining planned attempts unstarted; do not reset counts.
acceptance.confidence: Even5/5 is only a small current-scene pilot, not99% reliability or cross-task evidence.
acceptance.reset: Onsite plug restoration to documented holder seating; fixed target3 and installation, fresh initial RGB/CAN each time.
acceptance.version_freeze: Hash actual local model/scene/reference/controller/recorder and checks before acceptance; no parameter or threshold changes within it.

cost_targets.existing_reference_task_duration: Preserve current roughly55-second reference; no added global slowing/smoothing.
cost_targets.limits: Acquisition, reset, archive and publication time measured separately; old full-path baseline incomplete so no overall speedup claim.

stop_rules: No hardware operation before explicit resume and current onsite readiness.
Unexpected obstacle/contact, loss of trustworthy holding state, invalid recording, budget end, or inability to execute existing safe recovery stops the batch.
Two costly candidates without usable improvement or distinguishing evidence stop this branch; fewer if already uninformative.
No teaching/student/generalization allocation or automatic follow-on batch.
permission_needed: Approve this bounded batch and explicitly confirm right-arm resume, current work area clear, plug/socket electrically safe, emergency-stop access, and onsite reset/supported shutdown availability. Initial robot and plug state will be read; old readiness is not reused.
rollback: Use private current-local snapshot only for the changed component; preserve validated recording-clock and safety fixes. Historical success references remain reference-only.

authorization.source: User approved complete batch and explicitly confirmed onsite readiness in this chat
